turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
Plenty, as it turns out. I'm big into street photography — I shoot with a Leica rangefinder and I collect photography books, so a fair bit of my downtime goes on wandering cities with a camera and getting nothing worth keeping, which is most of the point.

I also love music, cooking, and travel — I've spent a good chunk of my life abroad, and I currently live in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] after stints in Paris and Brighton.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
Outside work I'm usually out with a camera doing street photography[[street-photo]] — it's the hardest kind to get right, you set out hoping a good frame just happens and mostly it doesn't. I collect photography books, I love to cook, and there's always music on while I do any of it[[music]]. I've also travelled a fair bit and lived in a few places along the way.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
A fair bit, as it happens. I'm a street photographer — I shoot with a Leica rangefinder and I'm forever drawn to places with a bit of a rough reputation. I collect photography books, I used to DJ and I still have music on constantly[[music]], and I love to travel — I once spent a year working my way around South East Asia and India.

Living in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] with a young family keeps me grounded between all that too.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
A fair bit, honestly. Street photography is the big one — I shoot with a Leica rangefinder and I'm forever wandering cities hoping a good frame turns up.[[street-photo]] I collect photography books, I love to cook, I used to DJ, and I've done a good chunk of travelling — I spent a year working my way around South East Asia and India once.

There's also just life in Bordeaux with my family, which keeps me nicely grounded.[[bordeaux]]
